thread:
monica: quick sync — planning the Hosted API initiatives for next quarter. goal: pick 3 priority slices across chat/completions/embeddings/rerank that we can finish to the launch bar.
monica: context: two enterprise customers pushed for lower-cost embeddings + a rerank alpha, and infra flagged latency regression at p95 for long chat sessions.
raj: +1. we should separate quick wins (config changes, batching) from bigger work (kv cache UX, model quantization ops).
luisa: FYI EngOps: Dedicated infra can provide a short-term burst pool for alpha customers if product promises are tight.
nate: from ML: rerank improvements mostly need small eval harness + retraining of scoring head, should be doable as a focused 3wk spike.
sophie: CS: both enterprise accounts asked for deterministic embedding stability + lower cost per 1k vectors. they want pilot in Q1.
monica: proposal: prioritize (1) embeddings cost reduction (auto-quantize + smarter caching), (2) rerank alpha (customer pilot + evals), (3) chat stability for long sessions (p95 latency). everything else goes to backlog. thoughts?
raj: technical concerns: auto-quantize needs infra support for multiple quant profiles + fallback. effort ~4-6 wks. caching improvements could be toggled per-customer.
ate: rerank eval plan sketch: small labeled set + online metric = NDCG@10 and regression alert. need product KRs: pilot with 2 customers, +10% NDCG.
luisa: deployment plan: we can do opt-in feature flags per org. require canary + rollback playbook. I can own rollout runbook.
sophie: success criteria from CS: embeddings cost down 30% for pilot orgs, and similarity drift <2% on weekly checks. for rerank, CS needs customer-facing report template.
monica: launch bar idea: (a) automation for quant+cache, (b) perf SLOs met for pilot (p50/p95), (c) clear regression alerts, (d) docs + SDK examples, (e) 2 pilot customers onboarded. all required.
raj: suggested scope negotiation: split embeddings into v1 (auto-quantize server-side + cache) and v2 (model-level quant with tooling). v1 is ~3 wks dev + 1 wk rollout. ok?
monica: that's reasonable. put v2 on roadmap after pilot.
nate: rerank timeline estimate: 3w spike + 2w integration + 1w pilot = 6w. need annotation budget.
luisa: tagging action items: Raj -> quant prototype, Nate -> rerank eval harness, Sophie -> customer pilot contacts, Monica -> OKR / doc + rollout acceptance criteria.
monica: OKR wording draft: "Hosted API: Reduce per-vector embedding cost by 30% for pilot customers and ship rerank alpha with >=10% improvement in NDCG for pilot users". comments?
sophie: wording looks good. add "+ no regression in chat p95 latency" to be safe.
monica: good call. final: add "maintain chat p95 <= 250ms for pilot orgs".
roadmap-bot: reminder: quarterly planning doc due in 5 days. link: https://drive.redwood/roadmap/q1-hosted-api
raj: blockers: need perf benchmarks for current quant approach. I'll post numbers by EOD tomorrow.
monica: great. next steps: owners start scoping tasks in JIRA, we reconvene Tue 10AM to finalize commits. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
